grammar_focus: KS3/27/51 一般过去时综合(教材 L75 Key structures,方案B换情节包):规则与不规则动词过去式(held/shone/came/ran/blew/shot/fell/took/won 与 entered/passed/handed/raced/shouted/crossed)、一般过去时叙事(过去连续动作)、过去时间状语(last Saturday/yesterday/two weeks ago)、否定与疑问(didn't / Did…?)
scene: 上周六,我们学校举办了一年一度的运动会。阳光灿烂,几百个家庭前来观看。我们班报名参加了接力赛,我跑最后一棒。哨声一响,选手们猛冲向前。起初我们落后了,我以为我们没戏了。但我们的第三棒超过了另外两人,把接力棒交到了我手里。我深吸一口气,拼尽全力地跑。人群欢呼起来,我刚好领先其他人冲过了终点线。我们以半秒之差赢了!我根本没料到会赢。那是我们班有史以来最棒的一次运动会。

grammar_card.title: KS3/27/51 一般过去时综合
grammar_card.intro: 本课复习一般过去时(讲过去发生、已经结束的事):①规则动词加 -ed(enter→entered, race→raced);②不规则动词要单独记(hold→held, come→came, run→ran, shoot→shot, fall→fell, take→took, win→won);③叙述过去一连串动作,都用过去式;④过去时间状语:last Saturday、yesterday、two weeks ago;⑤否定与疑问借助 did:didn't + 原形 / Did + 主语 + 原形。

rows: The whistle blew and the runners shot forward.
last Saturday / yesterday / two weeks ago
I didn't expect it. / Did your class win?

specialRules.rule: 美语里“足球”说 soccer(英式 football)、“运动鞋”说 sneakers(英式 trainers)、“体育课”说 gym class(英式 PE);本课已按美语写。
一般过去的否定和疑问都靠 did:didn't + 动词原形(didn't expect)、Did + 主语 + 动词原形(Did your class win?),动词本身不再变过去式。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Did the writer's class win the race?
options: Yes — they won by half a second
Yes — they won by a full minute

passage: Last Saturday our school held its yearly sports day. The sun shone, and hundreds of families came to watch. My class entered the relay race, and I ran the last leg. When the whistle blew, the runners shot forward. At first we fell behind, and I thought we had no chance. But our third runner passed two others and handed me the baton. I took a deep breath and raced as fast as I could. The crowd shouted, and I crossed the line just ahead of the others. We won by half a second! I didn't expect it at all. It was the best sports day our class ever had.
